about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: I'm a certified Systems Analyst and on my way to obtaining a Computer Engineering degree. Passionate about software development, I specialize in creating modern web applications, with experience in both frontend and backend. I work with technologies such as React, TypeScript, Java, C#, and PHP, applying solid design principles through UML diagrams.
about.paragraph2: I currently work as a Frontend Developer at Mapaprop, where I design and develop custom real estate websites according to specific client requirements. I use Figma to create visual prototypes and technologies such as PHP, TypeScript, Vue.js, and Tailwind CSS to implement interfaces. I handle the complete cycle: requirements gathering, design, development, and site delivery, in direct coordination with the technical team.
about.paragraph3: Previously, I worked as a Full Stack Developer at Access Informática, developing a web application to manage and display AI chat histories. You can see the project repository at this
about.paragraph4: I implemented authentication with Outlook and used technologies such as React, TypeScript, MongoDB, and Node.js.
about.paragraph5: Throughout my career, I have also gained experience in customer service, honing my problem-solving skills and managing interpersonal relationships. I currently manage a digital registration system for co-owner payments, which reflects my organizational capacity and technical precision.
about.paragraph6: My goal is to continue growing in the field of software development, facing new challenges that allow me to innovate and provide technological solutions that make a difference.

mapaprop.title: Frontend Developer

Development of components and complete pages when requirements exceed base functionalities. Autonomous management of the complete process—requirements, design, development, and delivery—in direct coordination with Mapaprop's technical team.
